run_relaxation_runner: run a RelaxationRunner to relax atomic structures using an ASE calculator and save results
create_relaxation_runner: create a RelaxationRunner with a calculator, input data, and optional heartbeat interval for preemption
calculate_relaxation_results: calculate relaxation results for a subset of structures split across multiple array jobs
write_relaxation_results: write relaxation calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
load_relaxation_checkpoint: load a previously saved relaxation checkpoint to resume interrupted structure relaxation runs
